label: Very Poor
rubric_description: Unusable. Broken navigation, frequent errors, or completely confusing layout.

label: Poor
rubric_description: Major design flaws. Frustrating to navigate with critical usability barriers.

label: Below Average
rubric_description: Hard to use. High effort required to accomplish basic tasks.

label: Slightly Below Average
rubric_description: Functional, but noticeable usability flaws and inconsistent visual cues.

label: Average
rubric_description: Basic functionality works, but the design is plain and lacks clear guidance or polish.

label: Above Average
rubric_description: Functional and reasonable to use, with minor design friction or room for cleanup.

label: Good
rubric_description: Easy to navigate, clear visual layout, and minor issues that do not disrupt the core experience.

label: Very Good
rubric_description: Smooth user experience, intuitive navigation, and clean visually.

label: Excellent
rubric_description: Highly polished, intuitive, and seamless. Exceeds expectations for usability.

label: Outstanding
rubric_description: Exceptional prototype. Flawless usability, highly engaging, and complete ease of use.
